title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 2nd - 3rd STAGE
native: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 スティール・ボール・ラン 2nd＆3rd STAGE
synopsis:
In the 2nd STAGE, a desert crossing spanning roughly 750 miles- the land that Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli must challenge, is home to the area that is feared as the "Devil's Palm." In 1875, a threat lurking in said desert wiped out a cavalry of 26 people, eliciting fear from the local native people. As ominous incidents begin to unfold, they are forced to realize that this race is far more than a mere competition. The two press forward, where countless hidden motives collide..

(Source: Warner Bros. Japan Anime, Netflix Anime, edited)

episodes.title: STEEL BALL RUN
episodes.synopsis:
After a fateful encounter with outlaw Gyro Zeppeli, former racing prodigy Johnny Joestar enters the Steel Ball Run, the first horse race across America.

(Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: The Sheriff's Request to Mountain Tim
episodes.synopsis:
After a shocking end to the 1st STAGE, abnormal murders unfold. Legendary cowboy Mountain Tim steps up to investigate as the tense 2nd STAGE begins.

(Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: The Desert-Born Outlaws
episodes.synopsis:
At camp, Johnny catches a glimpse of Gyro's past. Then the Boomboom Family strikes with an otherworldly power. The duo escapes — or so they think.

(Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: The Devil's Palm
episodes.synopsis:
Caught in the Boombooms' trap, a magnetic force threatens to tear Johnny, Gyro, and Mountain Tim apart. They learn about "Stands" and Johnny's body reacts.

(Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: The Terrorist from a Faraway Country
episodes.synopsis:
At a checkpoint, Oye — a man who knows Gyro's past — confronts the duo. His power to turn anything he touches into a bomb leaves them with nowhere to run.

(Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Gyro Zeppeli’s Destiny
episodes.synopsis:
Wounded and weary, the duo finds the Zombie Horse. As Gyro patches himself up, memories surface — revealing a family legacy steeped in duty and sacrifice.

(Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Tusk, Part 1
episodes.synopsis:
Near Mountain Valley, Gyro vanishes into thin air. Alone and under attack, Johnny suspects the mummified arm in his possession has made them both targets.

(Source: Netflix)
